set.body:
Objective
Specify the forward model x = A C-transpose y + epsilon as factorized A/C, target coding/metric/prior, residual covariance, training lineage and solver diagnostics. Preserve the artifact through Alder.

Authority and inputs
PRD: docs/plans/unified-mvpa-prd.md v0.2; requirements PAT-01, GLB-01, FND-05, PRED-01. Scientific/architecture/supplementary notes linked there preserve derivations and rationale. Planning baseline e071e83b3a23bc6f304b1e72625d6281d9cfc9ba plus untracked design documents is provenance, not a clean-tree or current-admission claim. Refresh only relevant sources/pins at claim time.

Owner role and starting seams
implementation; new global estimand/artifact in modules/mvpa; predictive lifecycle adapter. These are bounded ownership candidates, not a reservation of whole modules. Reserve exact touched paths when beginning; no assignee is fabricated by this plan.

Prerequisite packets
M1.04, M1.06, M0.05. Native Mote blocking edges are authoritative; stable keys/IDs are mapped in docs/plans/unified-mvpa-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. Categorical contrasts and identified multivariate features share the model without unlabeled vector targets.
2. Rank obeys min(p,q) and K-1 for K-class mean discrimination; binary/single-outcome rank is not presented as the number of anatomical networks.
3. Coordinate gauge, full-column-rank requirements, centering/intercepts and degenerate target policies are explicit.
4. No required dense p-by-q F or p-by-p covariance; artifact fields distinguish experimental numerical fit from qualified interpretation/inference.

Verification
sbt mvpaJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaJS/test
These are candidate owning-module gates at the planning baseline: resolve any renamed module/test IDs at implementation start, and include affected consumer/parity scenarios. Use independent oracles and explicit tolerances; never report pending tests as passing.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet and required owner-local tests/docs. Reuse Gale/Multivar kernels, resample4s designs, Alder lifecycle and existing response/locus/estimates facilities; provider gaps stay explicit and require consumer admission. Do not add legacy enum cases or permanent compatibility wrappers, duplicate orchestration, a new registry/runtime, broad repo refactors, or silently change the scientific estimand to pass a resource/statistical gate. Migrate/delete per the M0 ledger. No Git push/release publication or foreign-store mutation is authorized by this ticket.
At handoff attach exact revisions, commands/results, scenario IDs, failure/caveat status, artifacts and next consumer. Semantic, numerical, scope, resource and scientific evidence remain separate. Independent audit tickets must use independently derived expectations/review, not repeat the implementation helper; unresolved criteria keep the task open.
set.title: UMVPA-M3.02: Define the pattern-first fit artifact and identified target model
